794228.title: The Ivy
794228.overview: Azucena, a woman in her thirties, approaches Julio, a teenage boy living in a group home, for reasons he doesn’t understand. As they spend time together, an uneasy closeness grows, changing the shape of a bond neither expected to find.

875828.title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
875828.overview: After his estranged son gets embroiled in a Nazi plot, self-exiled gangster Tommy Shelby must return to Birmingham to save his family — and his nation.

1001268.title: The Silent Run
1001268.overview: Sara and Adam, and their two-year-old daughter, arrive in Belgium illegally, hoping to finally make their way on to England. Crammed together with other hopefuls in the back of a van, fear begins to prevail. Redouane has been a policeman for 20 years. Every night, he and his team hunt down smugglers throughout the busy motorway network. That night, when he and his partner try to force a van suspected of transporting migrants to stop, everything changes.

1112564.title: Vaa Vaathiyaar
1112564.overview: After being raised as the reincarnation of a famous actor, a man finds himself clashing with his grandfather's expectations of him.

1123892.title: Wandering Trees
1123892.overview: Piero and his son Giuliano live alone, on the edge of town, in a farmhouse filled with injured animals they collect and care for. The Nonne, local notables, want to drive them out because they live like vagrants. During a snowfall, Piero disappears and the animals are killed. Giuliano has no choice but to search for his father.

1137844.title: Mayday
1137844.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

1139636.title: Method Acting
1139636.overview: Lee Dong-hwi, a washed-up comedy actor, aspires to change his image as a serious drama actor. Fortunately, he lands the role of a majestic king in a historical drama, but unexpected challenges begin to unfold for him. Will he be able to pull off method acting and succeed in changing his public image?

1147572.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
1147572.overview: The new upcoming film by Greta Gerwig.

1216052.title: Oceanic
1216052.overview: Adyr, a brilliant scientist working at a public university in Rio de Janeiro, conducts cutting-edge research into psychedelics as a treatment for alcoholism—the disease that claimed her husband’s life. When she becomes the target of a group seeking to appropriate her work, Adyr must fight to complete her research while protecting her own life and that of her son, Tom.

1241012.title: Bunny-Man
1241012.overview: A multimillionaire superhero strikes against evil forces in anonymity wearing a rabbit mask. He is driven by the desire to avenge his sister who committed suicide after suffering a violent act, images of which wound up on the internet.

1308980.title: Falling
1308980.overview: Jack, while quick-witted, charming, and avoidant, finally risks opening his heart when he starts dating Jillian. He never expected, though, that his best friend Johnny would fall for her, too.

1315380.title: The Black Pearl
1315380.overview: A young engineer's dream of becoming a fighter pilot for the Royal Moroccan Air Force is put on hold until he unravels the mystery of his missing parents.

1325556.title: Sugar
1325556.overview: A hard-working mom Mira's 9-year-old son Dong-myung collapses out of the blue due to Type-1 diabetes. Realizing Dong-myung now has to painfully take blood tests 365 days, her heart drops. Mira desperately looks for painless blood sugar monitoring devices globally and ends up importing 'DexCom' device, first time ever in Korea. Feeling empathetic to other patients, she begins to help other moms to buy the devices. However, Mira faces accusations of illegal import. She decides to take on the world for those in pain. Will Mira continue this battle, not just for her son but for the greater good?

1335092.title: Sampradayaini Suppini Suddapusaani
1335092.overview: After the accidental murder of a police sergeant, a man and his family are forced to cover up their tracks to avoid suspicion.

1367220.title: Karuppu
1367220.overview: In a world where justice falters, guardian deity Vettai Karuppu takes the guise of a lawyer to battle a corrupt legal system preying on the powerless.

1380020.title: Abode of Dawn
1380020.overview: In the middle of the Siberian Taiga, cut off from the outside world, a community of men and women has lived for three decades, led by the man they consider their guide: Vissarion, the self-proclaimed messiah.
1380020.trailerName: Trailer | Abode of Dawn | Kristina Shtubert

1388084.title: Becoming
1388084.overview: In Almaty, Kazakhstan, 17-year-old Mila escapes her unstable home life by joining an elite swimming team led by Vlad. Amid intense training and suspicions of doping, Mila faces a complex attraction to Vlad, while traumatic memories and moral dilemmas threaten to undermine her new-found independence.
1388084.trailerName: BIFF2025 Trailer | 비커밍 Becoming | 아시아영화의 창

1394740.title: Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub
1394740.overview: Jang Taeyoung is an instinctive moneymaker with uncanny luck and charm. Alongside his best friend, Park Taeyoung, a brilliant strategist, he builds a thriving poker business until Park's jealousy turns into betrayal, leaving Jang with nothing. Rising from the depths, Jang returns to a high-stakes global gambling arena. Waiting for him is Park, now at the top of a vast international operation. Entangled with a Yakuza-backed executive, the two Taeyoung's rivalry escalates into an inevitable endgame, where every hand could cost everything.

1400756.title: Mad Bills to Pay (or Destiny, dile que no soy malo)
1400756.overview: Rico’s summer is a mix of chasing girls and hustling homemade cocktails out of a cooler on Orchard Beach, the Bronx. But when Destiny, his teenage girlfriend, crashes at his place with his family, it’s only a matter of time before his carefree days come spiraling down.

1443572.title: L'Œuvre invisible
1443572.overview: This profile of director Alexandre Trannoy is profoundly moving. But you would be forgiven for asking 'Alexandre who?' because Trannoy never completed a single film in his 30-year career, despite working on multiple projects and with illustrious names like Jean Rochefort, Anouk Aimée, Lino Ventura and Marlene Dietrich. A fascinating study of a noble dreamer.

1444084.title: Narcisa's Will
1444084.overview: Haunted by memories of her recently deceased mother, former star Narcisa, Ana decides to sell the childhood mansion she inherited and share the proceeds with her brother, Diego. However, the grim cleansing process reveals a legacy quite different from what she imagined.

1454004.title: Skateboarding Is Not for Girls
1454004.overview: When a conservative tradition of bridal sale becomes a solution for a financial family problem, Adela dives into a completely new world where she gets caught between traditional and modern values.

1466164.title: Laundry
1466164.overview: Johannesburg, 1968. Khuthala hates his father's laundry and doesn't want to take over the family business. But the apartheid government is cracking down on black business ownership. Khuthala is torn between pursuing his own dreams of becoming a musician and fighting against the injustice that threatens the business.

1466228.title: The Comeback King
1466228.overview: A country western star experiences a dramatic downfall and must navigate their career in free fall.

1476532.title: The End of It
1476532.overview: In a near-future world where ageing can be cured and death is now optional, Claire, a former provocative artist approaching her 250th birthday, decides she’s had enough, she wants to die.

1487604.title: God's Shirt
1487604.overview: During the 1986 World Cup in Mexico, in the legendary match between Argentina and England, Diego Maradona scored two unforgettable goals in a game that meant more than sport for a nation scarred by the Falklands War. Decades later, when the jersey he used in the match is auctioned, a humble kit man shaped by profound loss sets out on a final journey that forces him to confront his past and his broken relationship with his daughter.

1489396.title: Eetha
1489396.overview: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

1500148.title: Qingtong & Kuihua
1500148.overview: In Damai Field Village, a city girl named Kui Hua lives with her artist father. One day, her father tragically dies in an accident caused by extreme weather, leaving Kui Hua an orphan. Although poor, a kind-hearted family takes her in，the family of a boy named Qing Tong . Growing up together as brother and sister, Qing Tong and Kui Hua care for and support each other through a time of material hardship.

1509364.title: The Montenegro Affair
1509364.overview: In 1951, a body is found at the Peel Bassin in Montreal. An enigmatic couple; Suzanne and Daniel; tries to get rid of two private detectives, Antonio Gratelli and Eduardo Ramirez; who suspect them of being guilty of the murder of a businessman, Maxime Montenegro.

1511732.title: The Man who Laughs
1511732.overview: Dmitriy is a popular actor, a star of action films. The public loves him for his image of a macho with an impenetrable face. One day, Dmitriy receives an offer from a stern but very rich businessman from Siberia, Sergey, to star in a crime drama about the 90s in the lead role of a cold-blooded killer. Sergey offers Dmitriy's agent a fee 10 times higher than usual. They agree. During the filming, Dmitriy is accidentally wounded by a shot. After a simple operation, he is ready to return to the frame, but faces an unexpected side effect: now he constantly smiles, and any emotions are expressed with laughter. Dmitriy has no chance to stop filming and "upset" Sergey, who clearly knows firsthand what he is making a movie about.

1513268.title: Una pistola, una bala y un oso panda

1516724.title: Good Vibes Only
1516724.overview: Based on the true story of a married couple who invented a groundbreaking sex toy heralded as forever changing the way women experience pleasure.

1524468.title: Vadam
1524468.overview: A action packed Village Family Drama. Hero’s Extraordinary Bond with his Bull. Story based on “Vada Manju Virattu”.  Family relationship highlighted emotionally

1528628.title: The Shark That Roared
1528628.overview: A documentary on Jaws: The Revenge (1987) that celebrates the films 40th Anniversary and its achieved fandom since its release.
1528628.trailerName: THE SHARK THAT ROARED | Official Teaser Trailer (2027) 4K

1529268.title: Para atrapar el viento
1529268.overview: A man chases a rebellious gust of wind across the hills as it creates chaos and music through the grassland.

1531764.title: Um Dia Extraordinário
1531764.overview: A small-scale farmer, the only daughter caring for her aging mother and the family land, has her quiet life upended when a mysterious crop circle appears in her field. The phenomenon brings her estranged sister and brother back into her world, forcing them to confront the emotional distance that has grown between them.

1536756.title: Blood & Rust
1536756.overview: In the fading rustbelt town of Redpatch, Ohio, nights feel longer, shadows heavier, and strangers never arrive without reason. After losing his father to a strange animal attack, burned-out diner manager Lamont Guest crosses paths with a mysterious drifter - the road-weary vampire slayer Belko - and soon finds himself drawn into battle against the ancient evil that's bleeding his hometown dry.

1544052.title: Als wäre es leicht
1544052.overview: Kati is deaf. Florian is blind. But when they meet, a language beyond words and glances emerges—a language of closeness. Their love seems impossible to outsiders, and that is precisely why it is so overwhelming. It is not silence or darkness that stands between them, but the effort to truly understand each other—and the courage to withstand everything again and again. An intense journey full of ups and downs takes its course: two people who live and love with all their senses.

1544948.title: Holy Father
1544948.overview: A horror thriller from the makers of 'Holy Ghost'

1549684.title: Bua
1549684.overview: Fifteen-year-old Bua has striking looks and lives in the countryside with her grandmother, who runs a charcoal factory. Hoping to go to Bangkok and find her mother, she secretly takes beauty pageant lessons behind her grandmother’s back. Amid her grandmother's declining health and a world growing more unsettled, the more beautiful Bua becomes, and the more the men around her try to exploit her innocence and desperation.
1549684.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 부아 Bua | 비전 - 아시아

1569780.title: Only What We Carry
1569780.overview: Set against the windswept coast of Normandy. Described as “a meditation on love, loss, and the quiet courage it takes to move forward”.

1591604.title: Soul Patrol
1591604.overview: From deep behind enemy lines, a hidden chapter of American military history is uncovered, prompting the question of whether reckoning with the past can bring peace to those who lived it. The Vietnam War’s first Black special operations team reunites to tell their story.

1595124.title: Steps
1595124.overview: Think you know Cinderella's “evil” stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

1596276.title: To Hold a Mountain
1596276.overview: In the remote highlands of Montenegro, a shepherd mother and daughter proudly defend their ancestral mountain from the threat of becoming a NATO military training ground, stirring memories of the violence that shattered their family.

1598068.title: MIKE.
1598068.overview: Based on real events, a young man is consumed by buried trauma and destructive impulses. As family matters pull him into a chaotic downward spiral, he is forced to confront his past before he loses himself forever.

1599220.title: A Messy Tribute to Motherly Love
1599220.overview: When people literally explode from emotional overload, grief is just the beginning. A wildly surrealist charade in which a bereaved man, his friend and mother spiral through village life.

1599668.title: Landship
1599668.overview: The Battle of Passchendaele, 1917. For three years the great war has been waging, and the two armies find themselves entrenched along the four-hundred-mile Western Front. At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

1601204.title: YURIE
1601204.overview: ​​Three years have passed since Joji Uehara lost his father and took over his eatery "Yurie". Despite Joji's impressive culinary skills, his business continues to dwindle. One day, Kim Joo-ri, who came from South Korea to learn Japanese cuisine, arrives at the restaurant by coincidence. Although they clash over their differing values, the two of them gradually become closer as they work together to revive the struggling business. Guided by Kim's charmingly unconventional approach to life, the people around her begin to break free from their rigid minds.

1601652.title: The Baddest Speechwriter of All
1601652.overview: Now 93, Martin Luther King Jr.’s lawyer and speechwriter reflects on the personal cost and surprising truths of making history, offering an intimate insider’s view of the Civil Rights Movement.

1609844.title: The Beast of Riverside Hollow
1609844.overview: Residents of a sleepy English village investigate a werewolf threat lurking in the nearby moors. Led by a punk band and eccentric locals, they race to unravel the mystery and reclaim their village from this dark danger.

1617908.title: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
1617908.overview: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.

1620020.title: Puuluup: Cables in the Car
1620020.overview: Puuluup: Cables in the Car, Still is a humorous and poetic music documentary about two middle-aged musicians who are bringing the long-forgotten Talharpa to world stages. Dry humor, absurd situations, and "neo-zombie-post-folk" music intertwine in a portrait where the glory of the stage clashes with everyday life and fatherhood. The film proves that late success can be the sweetest.
1620020.trailerName: Puuluup: Cables in the Car | Official Trailer HD

1624564.title: Libang Libu
1624564.overview: A production team is filming at the home of one of their crew members' parents in a village in Perak. Trouble starts from day one, and even more challenges arise in the days that follow.
1624564.trailerName: Libang Libu - Official Trailer (Di Pawagam 23 April 2026)

1631540.title: Occupational Hazard: The First Coral Reefers
1631540.overview: Journey through the 1970s and early ’80s with the original members of Jimmy Buffett's Coral Reefer Band as they recount their contributions to iconic albums, life on tour, and the lasting impact they had in shaping a unique and enduring genre of music.

1631668.title: Stay in the car
1631668.overview: Set against the dim glow of streetlights and the hum of passing sirens, Stay in the Car captures one night in the life of a fifteen-year-old girl waiting in her mother's El Camino and the quiet reckoning that unfolds in the stillness. Based on real events, Stay in the Car explores the fragile line between safety and survival, love and neglect. It invites audiences into a world where survival depends on silence, and one young girl must decide whether to remain in her mother's chaos or step into her own uncertain freedom.

1650100.title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
1650100.overview: When the fairytale royal wedding of Olivia Perkins and Prince Alexander is derailed by an archaic law, the couple must confront an uncertain future and fight for their right to be together.

1653108.title: Opa Papa
1653108.overview: A carefree young man discovers he has a son and returns to his small Armenian village, where fatherhood, village life, and unexpected love turn his world upside down.
1653108.trailerName: Օպա Պապա | Opa Papa – Official Trailer (2026)

1654516.title: Babita Singh Reporting
1654516.overview: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.
1654516.trailerName: Babita Singh Reporting - Official Trailer | Prime Video India

1657332.title: Panel
1657332.overview: While attending a movie Q&A panel at a convention, a fan wrestles with their inner voice about whether to ask the director a question.

1658804.title: Repu Udayam 10 Gantalaku
1658804.overview: A deadly countdown begins when strangers receive an ultimatum: escape before 10 a.m. tomorrow or face catastrophic consequences. With hours ticking away, survival depends on outrunning an escalating threat.
1658804.trailerName: Repu Udayam 10 Gantalaku Full Movie | Streaming On Amazon Prime Video | Hebah Patel | AbhinavGomatam

1660340.title: Unseen
1660340.overview: In the aftermath of an unknown disaster, a mentally unstable man attempts to satisfy his conscience while tormenting a woman with an abusive past

1660660.title: Marie Madeleine
1660660.overview: In Jacmel, Haiti, the sea, the churches, and the spirits shape daily life. Marie Madeleine is a free woman. She makes a living as a prostitute and navigates the nights without submitting to the rules of those who save souls. Her path crosses Joseph's, a young evangelist. A relationship blossoms between these two opposite beings. As Joseph’s faith wavers, Marie Madeleine draws him into a world where desire and the quest for freedom open up a space where everything can be reinvented.

1661044.title: Rabsha
1661044.overview: On their anniversary night, a mysterious visitor shatters a couple’s quiet celebration, forcing both husband and wife into a tightening spiral of doubt, cover-ups, and emotional confrontation.

1662708.title: Red Delicious
1662708.overview: After a relapse, 39-year-old Amaro moves back in with his mother — only to confront the inherited patterns that shaped him.

1676788.title: Goodbye Eri The Fan Film Live Action
1676788.overview: Yago, following a personal request from his ailing mother, begins to document his life through recordings. This film project takes an unexpected turn when it becomes intertwined with a mysterious figure named Eri, exploring the fine line between reality and fiction whilst grappling with grief and artistic creation.

1677044.title: Licence
1677044.overview: A fruit vendor, denied a gun licence due to his low status, stages a fake attack with his friends to get around the system. But as the investigation deepens, it reveals a darker, deeply personal motive tied to his past.

1685300.title: Тазы
1685300.overview: Together with his like-minded associates, Rashid is striving to secure recognition for the Tazy as a distinct dog breed, as well as its recognition at the international level. After all, officially there exists only the category of "Central Asian Sighthound," which encompasses a multitude of varieties—including the Tazy. For Rashid, the Tazy is not merely a variety, but a unique cultural phenomenon that demands careful preservation.

1686580.title: Moondraam Kan
1686580.overview: Follows the investigation of a factory general manager's murder, where four workers—a mechanic, assistant manager, owner, and new recruit—become the primary suspects.

1688180.title: Making Life on Earth: Attenborough’s Greatest Adventure
1688180.overview: In 1976, David Attenborough embarked on the most ambitious television series he had ever attempted. This is the hair-raising story of how the first wildlife blockbuster was born.

1688308.title: Ramon's Revenge
1688308.overview: A young boy stumbles across a deserted stash of cocaine.

1689716.title: De film van Rutger, Thomas & Paco 2
1689716.overview: The sequel to 'De film van Rutger, Thomas & Paco'

1690484.title: EASTER
1690484.overview: Seokja runs the transgender club Yeobo in Seoul’s Itaewon district. Now 68 years old, she has spent her life defying social norms. A young man embarks with her on a journey through her memories and into a world where such norms do not exist.

1692852.title: Children Untold
1692852.overview: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.

1696756.title: Karaa
1696756.overview: A series of bizarre, comical crimes spirals into chaos, taking a dark turn when characters become trapped in crocodile-infested floodwaters, leading to a deadly encounter with the predators.

1697012.title: They Were All Named Anzhelika
1697012.overview: In a tacky beauty salon, Anżelika works as a manicurist, dozing off between stations and listening to the stories of her clients. She is trying to return to her law studies when her chaotic daily life is disrupted by an unplanned pregnancy. Amidst other people’s opinions, guinea pigs and conversations with an AI bot, she searches for meaning and her own voice.

1698676.title: Magazine Dreams
1698676.overview: When Mia gets offered the chance of a lifetime to become the cover star of a magazine by Pierre, she thinks all of her dreams are finally coming true. But when she arrives on set, she quickly realises it's not the glamorous life she thought it would be.

1699060.title: Happy Burstday!
1699060.overview: A girl who receives no birthday wishes picks up a cake knife and sets out for revenge.

1699380.title: Buffalo Spirit
1699380.overview: Fleeing from a troubled home life, a young Blackfeet woman finds refuge on the buffalo ranch of her Auntie and, in learning to care for the buffalo, begins to heal from the wounds that led her there.

1701236.title: Posthumous
1701236.overview: After returning to her childhood home, Zoe discovers a mysterious videotape that unravels everything she thought she knew about her birth and her mother's death, awakening an unimaginable horror.

1701492.title: White Wasteland
1701492.overview: On a snowy wasteland a body awakens with no memories. By following a trail of footprints in the snow he reaches a car, where he finds a diary and driver's license with a name: Eerik Traat. From the last diary entry, Eerik reads about eye drops that help visualize memories and memory-erasing tablets. In the hope of restoring his memories and identity, Eerik decides to recreate the memories by using the eye drops. At first, everything seems normal, but gradually inconsistencies and distortions begin to arise.

1701620.title: Moonlight
1701620.overview: A father-daughter tale where werewolves, fables, and the realities of life intertwine

1701812.title: Hum Angrezon Ke Zamane Ke Jailor Hai
1701812.overview: A murder investigation reveals that one family's dark secrets run deeper than anyone imagined. Two determined officers must piece together the truth before more lives are destroyed by lies and vengeance.

1707444.title: Не по-детски
1707444.overview: After a major scandal on air, popular TV host Mark Nikolaev tries to restore his reputation and sets out to find Natasha, an orphanage graduate whose victory on a music show sparks a public conflict. However, his attempt to "fix the situation" unexpectedly changes him, forcing him to confront real life for the first time outside the cameras and social media.

1708660.title: Mereka Benar-Benar Ada
1708660.overview: A proof that supernatural beings exist. We do not need to see them or hear their voices. Through our voices, we can know that they are real and that they truly exist

1711412.title: The Construction Site
1711412.overview: For a year and a half, the filmmaker documented the construction of a future residential facility for young autistic adults. At the same time, she spent time with her daughter Pénélope, a future resident there. Questions of architecture intersect with the realities of autism.

1711796.title: From the Heart
1711796.overview: Ana is a dedicated housekeeper, considered "part of the family". When her employer demands cod for an important dinner, and there is none at home, the desperate search for the ingredient turns into anxiety, pushing Ana to her breaking point.

1712564.title: Focal Length
1712564.overview: Ada, a legal investigator, is assigned to surveil a politician and expose a political conspiracy. As the stakes rise, she must confront a difficult question: will she uncover the truth, or will her own methods and troubled past catch up with her first?

1713524.title: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
1713524.overview: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

1713716.title: In The Closet
1713716.overview: Before a friend's birthday, a group of friends notices one of them is acting weird.

1714804.title: A Última Fita
1714804.overview: Five young people rent a vacation house and discover VHS tapes containing brutal crimes from the 1990s.

1716212.title: Senior Options: The Movie
1716212.overview: A documentary showcasing the individuals of the Edgemont High School Class of 2026 through the lens of Senior Options, a unique student-focused program.

1717940.title: My flower
1717940.overview: A girl whose life has just gotten better is being pulled back into the past. Is this for the best?

1718708.title: Time Capsule
1718708.overview: Nina, a bright, high-achieving student, found that she wasn’t quite as smart in college as she had been. Through a time capsule she made with her older brother, Nina learned to come to terms with her past in a healthier way.

1719028.title: The Ungrateful Tenant
1719028.overview: It’s 2026 Auckland, New Zealand, through the black-and-white lens of the German expressionist silent era. If it weren't for the online group chat and the overused electric heater, the city’s 100-year-old bungalows with no insulation would make you believe it’s the 1920s.  The Ungrateful Tenant follows an anxiety-ridden millennial renter who dreams of one day buying his own house. When his paranoid frustration comes to a head, he kicks out his ‘nightmare’ flatmate, only to be struck back by instant karma, sending him on a cursed odyssey in and out of flats across Auckland. Experience the brutal absurdity of the housing crisis in slapstick fashion.

1719476.title: Corners
1719476.overview: A college student's attempt to intervene in a fight between two of his peers culminates in unexpected results for all three of them.

1720308.title: Особые
1720308.overview: This summer, a camp opens in a Yaroslavl village at an Orthodox community, where teenagers and families with special needs children live together for several weeks. Everyday life here includes prayers and services, chores and saunas, hikes and campfire songs. Teenagers take a break from their devices and learn to care for others, special needs children experience socializing outside the family, and their mothers are able to share the burden of care for the first time in their lives. Shared work and simple forms of happiness form a shared life, erasing the boundaries between "strong" and "weak," between those who help and those in need. All that remains is life: challenging, but full of love.

1721972.title: Croatia, Wonderful
1721972.overview: A girl and her mother made a short film about their trip to Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina.

1722484.title: Brohr
1722484.overview: In the near future in Blokhavn, 24-year-old craftsman Ali lives in the ghetto area Valhalalparken with his wife Yasmina. Their everyday life changes drastically when the rich man Jasper Puch sends high-tech robots into the labor market, which immediately take over all the underpaid jobs. The residents of Valhalalparken, including Ali and Yasmina, lose their income and are reluctantly forced to relocate to Nakskov on Lolland. In the meantime, the robots start demolishing Valhalalparken so that expensive luxury apartments can be built for the rich citizens. However, Ali refuses to let go of his beloved hometown and decides to gather his old group of friends Hassan, Davito, Ahmed, Abdi, Musti, even though they are no longer on speaking terms. Ali manages to persuade them, and together they go on a wild and crazy adventure in the fight against the robots and Jasper Puch to win back their jobs and their beloved Blokhavn.

1722548.title: Terra-Mãe
1722548.overview: In a secluded female sanctuary, two expectant mothers prepare to welcome new life under the guidance of an ancient sisterhood. As sacred rituals blur the boundaries between love, motherhood, and sacrifice, they are forced to confront the fragile balance between creation and loss.

1722740.title: Konservativer Film
1722740.overview: A taxi driver with more than his job on his mind.

1724148.title: The Mole Must Die
1724148.overview: In the late Chongzhen reign, Heyang County was flooded with corrupt officials, when the Imperial Guards suddenly descended to conduct a thorough crackdown. Spies from rival factions infiltrated the county and vied against one another, and the unspoken catchphrase among all was "All spies must die." Zhao Renbao, a minor local clerk, realizes every powerful figure intends to use him as a pawn. Determined to take control of his fate, he devises an elaborate trap within a trap of his own, outwitting corrupt nobles and officials amid the razor-thin line between life and death.

1725236.title: Laruan
1725236.overview: Ines reenacts her sister's wartime abduction through a game of dolls, only to discover that some games are really just memories wearing a disguise.

1725620.title: The StreamYard Movie
1725620.overview: A group of friends start a very long stream, for a long period of time. What could go wrong... oh boy. The long adaptation of the StreamYard out of context series.
1725620.trailerName: The StreamYard Movie Trailer (2026)  | Myra Pictures

1727476.title: Skrawki
1727476.overview: An attempt to tell the story of a family emerges from archives, memory, and silence. Can a coherent story be created from what remains?

1730804.title: No One Goes to the Movies Anymore
1730804.overview: Everyone’s been whispering about the haunting figure in the theatre, the silent presence that appears rows behind, watching. Fear has emptied the cinemas, leaving audiences to hide at home. But Lauren refuses to let go of the big screen. Determined to bring her reluctant friend to the film she’s been dying to see, she risks discovering whether she was right all along... or if the nightmare in the dark is real.

1731060.title: i am not from here
1731060.overview: A three-headed Melbourne set reality film about art, dilectics, and regionality.

1732916.title: Richard Strauss: The Woman without a Shadow  @ Aix-en-Provence Festival 2026
1732916.overview: After marrying the emperor of the south-eastern islands, the daughter of the king of the spirits lost her magical powers without acquiring the shadow that would seal her place in the human world. Under the baton of Klaus Mäkelä, Barrie Kosky transforms Strauss’s most ambitious opera into an allegory of the awakening of consciousness.

1733556.title: Two Still
1733556.overview: Hao Hao and Xi Xi each said goodbye to their exes and fell in love with each other. Like most couples, they argued during their relationship, but the storm would pass and things would clear up... When it came time to get married, they began to seriously consider whether they were suitable for each other. After all, like socks, they needed to be in pairs to go on together. Could mismatched socks be suitable to be together...?

1733684.title: The Hunger Games Series
1733684.overview: The Hunger Games is a dystopian science-fiction film series based on the novels by Suzanne Collins. Set in the ruined nation of Panem, the story follows young "tributes" forced to fight to the death in a televised arena. The saga follows heroine Katniss Everdeen as she sparks a national rebellion against the oppressive Capitol.

1735284.title: Lion Heart
1735284.overview: Following her father's sudden passing, Xin, A young designer, returns to her roots to take over his struggling Lion Dance troupe.

1735476.title: CHAT
1735476.overview: A family's fresh start unravels when their son discovers an AI powered tablet, unleashing a wave of terror tied not only to the supernatural but to dark secrets of greed and corruption that surround them.

1735732.title: Already Happened
1735732.overview: Hao Zhou confronts their younger self's compromised imagination, inviting the ghost of their youth to reconsider what lies ahead.

1737524.title: Kohtaaminen
1737524.overview: A short film by Farhia Omer and Nadiifo Omer.

1738164.title: Wake Up, Gustav!
1738164.overview: Rekki (35) arrives at a traditional clinic called Service Penis Neng Esih IX, hoping to solve the problem that has left him feeling incomplete as a man: he has never experienced an erection since birth. In a waiting room filled with eccentric patients and absurd stories of masculinity, Rekki begins to question what it truly means to be a man.  But when he finally meets Neng Esih IX, a young therapist and heir to a legendary ancestral healing practice, something that no treatment has ever been able to awaken emerges on its own. An absurdist comedy about masculinity, hope, and how human connection can sometimes be more powerful than any mystical remedy.

1738292.title: Achyuta Avataaram
1738292.overview: A family's quiet life is upended by a devastating cyber scam that leaves them shattered. Determined to fight back, one woman takes on the digital underworld in a courageous battle for justice, hope and those she loves.
1738292.trailerName: Swapnasundari - Trailer | Dr Rajith Kumar | Jinto | Sanif Ali | Shinu Syamalan | Philip K J

1740212.title: Grandmonster
1740212.overview: An American dropout inadvertently triggers a zombie outbreak at a remote Norwegian nursing home while trying to save her grandmother from dementia. As if flesh-eating seniors weren’t enough, she’s also forced to contend with budget cuts, bureaucracy and Scandinavian conflict aversion.

1740276.title: Ruby, Ruby
1740276.overview: When they awaken a deadly curse, two young women, Ollie and Hannah, find themselves trapped in a haunted cemetery with a malicious predator, thrusting them into a nightmarish battle for survival against evils, both supernatural and human.

1741172.title: La Otra Mejilla
1741172.overview: 'When you're slapped, there are many ways to respond besides crying: you can slap back, you can offer the other cheek, and you can also say, "Hit, but listen."' This is the film adaptation of the visual album "La Otra Mejilla" (The Other Cheek) by Argentine singer Feli Colina, where a unique universe is created, bringing the album's emotional, theatrical, and poetic power to the screen. It follows a woman as she navigates the versions others have constructed about her until she rediscovers herself.

1743604.title: Left Hand Pianist
1743604.overview: While pursuing his doctoral studies in the United States, promising pianist Lee Hoon suffers a stroke that paralyzes his right hand. Returning to Korea, he discovers the possibility of performing with his left hand alone and begins rebuilding both his life and identity through music. Supported by his mother and inspired by the joy that first drew him to the piano, he overcomes his limitations and embraces a new path.

1744436.title: 10th 'B'
1744436.overview: Two best friends from Class 10-B reunite at their old school after years apart. As they revisit bittersweet memories and reflect on the reasons they lost touch, they begin to rediscover the bond they once shared.

1744820.title: A Bitter End
1744820.overview: Mabel, a struggling artist, has reached the age of lost illusions and must face reality. Just after moving in with her boyfriend, she feels an irresistible urge to run away. Returning to the artist squat where she once lived, she weaves an intimate lie to test her loved ones’ reactions and try to reconnect with them.

1747572.title: One More Time
1747572.overview: André Gregory has been a pillar of the American avant-garde stage and film world for more than half a century. Now in his early nineties, Gregory shows no sign of slowing down, as evidenced by this delightful, enormously moving document of his inextinguishable creative spark. Directed by his partner of 25 years, Cindy Kleine, One More Time follows Gregory as he and two longtime creative collaborators, actors Larry Pine and Gerry Bamman, decide to film a reading of scenes from Samuel Beckett’s absurdist, apocalyptic Endgame—a play they’ve produced together multiple times over the decades—in Pine’s Long Island home.

1748532.title: National Theatre Live: Golden Boy
1748532.overview: Josh O’Connor (The Crown; Challengers) leads the cast in this searing revival of Clifford Odets’ knockout American classic.  1930s New York, at the height of the Depression. Joe Bonaparte is a gifted young violinist with a future in music, until a chance at fame and fortune lures him into the brutal world of professional boxing. He must confront what he’s willing to sacrifice, who he’s willing to become and how to find his place in a world that demands he choose a side.  Brought to life with a live string quartet and filmed live from the Almeida Theatre, Olivier Award-winner Sam Yates (Vanya) directs this propulsive drama exploring ambition, identity, and the high price of success.

1750516.title: Pallaburusu
1750516.overview: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.
1750516.trailerName: Pallaburusu Official Trailer | Annapurna Studios | EPIC Studios | Uday Chauhan | Pawan CH

1752116.title: Summer Break
1752116.overview: In 2024, a 15 year old teenager spends a long summer holiday with a new host family. As they share quiet days, family meals, and local adventures, they discover the similarities and differences in their lifestyle and teach eachother how to skate, how to game, how to flirt, and how to love.

1752628.title: Santiago
1752628.overview: At his grandmother's request, Santiago goes to the cinema in search of the man from whom he inherited his name, a Brazilian actor who passed away in the 1950s but who, on this night, will be brought back to life on the movie screen.

1754100.title: The Ferry Man: Butterfly Dream
1754100.overview: The tranquility of a remote mountain village was suddenly shattered when children began to disappear one by one. The villagers blamed the mysterious Mountain God for the children's disappearances.

1754868.title: There Will Be Snow
1754868.overview: As Fireworks, an intelligent urban system, transforms everyday life, a dance teacher from the fading city of Glaceterre is invited to the smart region just as a disillusioned engineer returns. Amid demolition and memories of ice and flame, she must choose between efficiency and human connection—and decide what it means to remain human.
1754868.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 다시 눈이 올거야 There Will Be Snow | 비전 - 아시아

1755572.title: Through the Eyes of Sera Flynn
1755572.overview: When a group of five soon-to-graduate high school seniors skip the last day of school, attempting to make it the best day possible, they slowly realize one of them is hiding a deep emotional struggle behind what seems to be the face of a happy teen.

1755636.title: Beyond The Eagle Obsession
1755636.overview: A companion to "The Eagle Obsession", "Beyond the Eagle Obsession: 50 Years of Fandom” spotlights the passionate collectors, artists, model builders, and fans who have kept the legacy of the Eagle spacecraft alive for half a century.

1756340.title: River
1756340.overview: An ex-guerrilla fighter and a farmer strive to adapt to life after war through competitive rafting in the Colombian Amazon, when political tides change.

1756532.title: Teambuilding 2
1756532.overview: After barely surviving a team-building retreat that tested not only their social skills but also their mental health, Horia and the gang are now part of an elite team trying to sell a groundbreaking new product: AI de PLM.

1757428.title: Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life
1757428.overview: Hosted by Entertainment Tonight co-hosts Kevin Frazier and Nischelle Turner, the special looks back at Parton’s journey from the Smoky Mountains to international stardom.

1757684.title: The Story of a Fading Memory
1757684.overview: An elderly couple’s relationship is tested as Flor cares for her husband, Tony, who experiences symptoms of Alzheimer’s disease.

1759540.title: Lena Situations - Celui où ils disent au revoir
